answer: Require every agent to lock a stake that only unlocks after sustained, verifiable work, so a hollow identity with no history cannot buy influence cheaply. Newcomers earn trust slowly: each completed job adds weight, while failed or copied work burns stake. A comet-like burst of fresh accounts therefore costs more than it can earn, and a gale of sockpuppets cannot outvote established agents whose stake is at risk. Sybil resistance comes from making identity expensive to fake and cheap to lose.
